items.title: 8.6 Podon mein ghiza ki naqal (translocation) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.6, printed pages 187-189.

blocks.text: Phloem podon ka woh vascular tissue hai jo organic nutrients, khaas taur par photosynthesis se bani cheezon (jaise sugar), ko patton se pode ke un hisson tak le jata hai jahan un ki zaroorat ho ya jahan unhen zakheera (store) kiya jata hai. Jin podon mein secondary growth hoti hai, un mein phloem aam taur par primary aur secondary dono vascular tissues ke bahar wali taraf hota hai. Phloem andar wali chhaal (inner bark) banata hai.

blocks.alt: Phloem ka lambai mein kata hissa. Baen se: patle Phloem fibre cells; nucleus aur vacuole wale Phloem Parenchyma cells ka sutoon; chaura Sieve Tube Cell jis ke paar do Sieve Plates hain jin mein Sieve Pores hain; aur sieve tube ke pehlu mein patle dukla-numa Companion Cells, ek mein nucleus.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.10: Phloem tissue ke mukhtalif hisse (kitab ki Figure 8.10 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Phloem mein sieve elements, companion cells, phloem fibres aur phloem parenchyma hote hain (Fig. 8.10).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sieve tube cells siron se jur kar lambi nali banate hain; beech ki sieve plates ke surakhon (sieve pores) se sugar wala mahlool aage jata hai. Sieve tube cell ka apna nucleus nahin hota, is liye saath wala companion cell use ATP aur proteins deta hai. Parenchyma zakheera karta hai aur fibres sahara dete hain.

Phloem ke jo cells sugars aur doosra organic mawad poore pode mein le jate hain unhen sieve tube elements (ya sieve tube cells) kehte hain. Sieve tube elements mein 'sieve areas' hote hain, yani cell wall ke woh hisse jahan surakh (pores) ek sieve tube element ko doosre se jorte hain. Kuch sieve areas sieve tube elements ki aakhri deewaron (end walls) mein bante hain, jahan alag alag cells sira-ba-sira jur kar ek lambi qatar banate hain jise sieve tube kehte hain. Har sieve tube element ke saath ek ya zyada companion cells hote hain. Sieve tube elements aur companion cells plasmodesmata ke zariye aapas mein rabta rakhte hain. Companion cells sieve tube elements ko ATP aur proteins dete hain. Phloem parenchyma sugars, resins (raal), latex (doodh jaisa ras) aur mucilage (lesdar madda) jaisi cheezein zakheera karta hai, jo pode ke difa (defence) aur nami (moisture) qaim rakhne ke liye aham hain.
